storyModal.title: MAISON DE LOUP ATELIER
storyModal.subtitle: THE HOUSE OF THE WOLF
storyModal.visionTitle: The Power of the Wolf & Global Turkish Design
storyModal.visionText:
Maison de Loup… Translated literally from French: “The House of the Wolf.”

The genesis of our atelier draws from the deep, mythic symbolism of the wolf in Turkish culture. The wolf embodies supreme freedom, independence, courage, and intuition. We translate this powerful emblem into the modern identity of an international luxury fashion brand.

Maison De Loup Atelier’s overarching vision is to position Turkish design excellence at the forefront of global fashion capitals. Quality is our unwavering pillar — from bespoke canvassing to premium virgin wools and immaculate finishings.
storyModal.missionText:
Nurtured by the richness of Turkish design culture and local manufacturing excellence; uniting modern silhouettes with uncompromising quality, authenticity, and accessibility.

Designing versatile, commanding, and timeless creations that empower women across global geographies to express their identity with unapologetic confidence.
storyModal.strategyTitle: 3 Core Axes Centered on the Tailored Blazer
storyModal.strategyText: At the nucleus of Maison De Loup Atelier stands the tailored women’s blazer. The blazer is our signature silhouette and the ultimate embodiment of our brand DNA. Around it orbits an engineered capsule wardrobe designed to elevate women from day to evening.
storyModal.strategyAxes:
3 Core Axes of Our Product Strategy:
1. Signature Creations: Masterfully tailored virgin wool blazers crafted with bespoke craftsmanship.
2. Complementary Capsule: Wide-leg trousers, poplin shirts, silk skirts, and slip dresses tailored to frame the blazer.
3. Accessible Brand DNA: Dynamic luxury essentials designed for modern urban rhythms without compromising quality.
storyModal.founderTitle: Over 20 Years of Textile & Fashion Mastery
storyModal.founderText:
More than 20 years of deep textile and fashion industry mastery serves as the fundamental cornerstone of Maison De Loup Atelier. Spanning decades across fine knitwear, worsted tailoring, denim, and leathercraft, this comprehensive expertise allows us to govern every millimeter from conceptual sketch to fabric mill and atelier finish.

Our mission is not merely to craft aesthetic garments, but to build a lasting, sustainable, and globally revered fashion house that proudly champions Turkish design mastery on the world stage.

sizeGuide.title: WOMEN'S SIZE & FIT CHART
sizeGuide.subtitle: All measurements are in standard centimeters (cm). Engineered for an architectural, commanding silhouette.
sizeGuide.bustDesc: Measure around the fullest part of your bust, keeping the measuring tape horizontal and parallel to the floor.
sizeGuide.waistDesc: Measure around your natural waistline at the narrowest point, keeping the tape comfortably loose.
sizeGuide.hipsDesc: Stand with feet together and measure around the fullest part of your hips and rear.
sizeGuide.fitDesc: Our blazers feature structured Italian shoulder canvassing. If in between sizes, choosing the next size up is recommended.
